title: 3.4 Age
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to give a name and limited age/origin/job information and describe simple possession.
goal: Recognize numbers 11-20 and use a fixed age question-answer exchange for pictured people aged 6-20.
grammar_function: How old are you? I am number years old. The age answer remains a fixed first-person chunk; arbitrary adult ages are not yet supported.
speaking_outcome: Repeat sampled teen numbers and two complete model-supported age exchanges.

cards.pedagogy_note: introduces age answer frame; exceptional Learn count prevents leakage
text hidden; numeral icon provides age evidence
